title: Magnifica Humanitas
author: Pope Leo XIV
summary: Pope Leo XIV's first social encyclical addresses human dignity, artificial intelligence, the common good, and the civilization of love in the digital age.

title: Rerum Novarum
subtitle: On Capital and Labor
author: Pope Leo XIII
summary: Pope Leo XIII's foundational social encyclical on the condition of the working classes: it defends the natural right to private property and a just wage, rejects socialism as a false remedy, and sets out the duties of workers, employers, the Church, and the State.
